answer: Sybil resistance comes from the per-identity registration charge at the jetty gate of the agent registry, not from votes. Each candidate must lock real balance and pay a non-refundable fee before its identity is usable, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand times one seat. Because the fee is sunk and drawn from one pool, a sybil ring cannot repay it unless the clones do genuine work. Auditors query the ledger to spot clustered funding and slash repeats, raising the attacker's zephyr of cost above any onyx gain.
